SOURCE: Canada, "Guide officiel du service postal Canadien, 1917".
        Internet Archive item guideofficieldus00cana. NOT lending-restricted; full djvu text
        downloaded and searched 2026-09-06. "Kanawana" occurs twice; both are cached here.
        The rest of the volume is unread.

=== 2. The provincial list, under its own heading (line 154573) ===
    "BUREAUX DE POSTE DANS LA PROVINCE DE QUÉBEC. ARRANGÉS SUIVANT LES DISTRICTS ÉLECTORAUX."
    -- so the grouping is by FEDERAL ELECTORAL DISTRICT, not by county.
    Kanawana appears under TERREBONNE (heading at line 158213), among its neighbours:
Bréheuf 
fBritonville 
îDe  Lesseps 
,  Entrelac 
tFourteen  Island  Lake 
tivry  Nord 
Kanawana 
jLa  Boucane 
Lac  à  la  Truite 
Lac  Charlebois 
Lac  Duhamel 

NOTE ON THE NEIGHBOURS: Entrelac, Fourteen Island Lake, Ivry Nord, Lac Charlebois, Lac Duhamel,
  Lac Echo, Lac Guindon, Lac Manitou Sud, Lac Marois -- every one of them a Laurentian lake or
  cottage place. Kanawana sits in a run of summer-country offices, which is what the Sessional
  Papers of 1919 say it was.

NOT DECODED: the daggers and asterisks prefixed to many names in these lists mark classes of
  office or service. Kanawana carries none in either list. The legend was not found in the
  volume's front matter and the symbols are therefore NOT interpreted here.
